versions.explanation: Grading 197th Street, between 118th Ave and 119th Ave, is necessary because after any rain the accumulation of water prevents homeowners from exiting and entering the street. versions.request: Provide a new or expanded health care facility
versions.explanation: There is a need for a full scale, quality hospital in the district providing and meeting the needs of the community. We have a number of Primary health care facilities in the district, but they do not meet all the needs of the community regarding major healthcare. We are the second largest Community Board in the city and growing with no major medical facility.
versions.response: Further investigation is required. Contact the agency.
